shared_elements: elaborate headdress / headband with banded decoration
rounded-topped upright slab/monolith carved on its face
horizontal banded register across the upper zone
justification: Both depict anthropomorphic imagery in shallow relief on a rounded-topped upright stone, sharing a banded headdress element across the top zone, curvilinear scroll forms and a circular disc motif set on the body/torso area. However A shows a crowded multi-figure narrative in profile beneath a register of sign-like elements, whereas B is a single massive frontal figure whose face and torso ornaments dominate the whole surface, so the compositions and figure relationships differ substantially.
